notes_for_editor: Thin record: the only source is list row GA295 on the tnlandforms.us page (codes BLL-65152, usgs, gfc-814, all copied as printed and not interpreted). Searches and a check of the Lakeland, Georgia Wikipedia page found no tower or fire-lookout mention. The record is not in the cached NHLR or FFLOS Georgia folders, and live fetches of those sites failed with connection resets, so retry before publishing. A search hit for a Lanier overlook tower concerned Lake Martin in Alabama and is not this site. The list's elevation column has no unit on the page, so the story gives 183 without one; the brief's elevation_m 55.8 assumes feet. Status and access remain unknown. Fact-check pass 2026-10-21: removed the unstated feet and metre conversion, and reworded the 'Many were scrapped and sold' sentence. The story is about 116 words, short of the 120-word target, because the sources support no more.
